name: 欠席時の担当枠の扱い
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0018 欠席時の担当枠の扱い component. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source is authoritative for radio-control glyph geometry, optical proportions, alignment, spacing, selected state and fine details; Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized copy guide. Do NOT copy its three identical mint pills: source has three RADIO CHOICES with THIRD selected. Image3 approved bus is white card/quiet elevation style only.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, one compact logical640x167 WHITE rounded card with fine neutral boundary and soft subtle shadow. Header left modest bold14/24 「10月18日（日）」; right quiet12/16 status 「公開済み」, restoring source Published label omitted in mock. Below regular12/16 exact summary 「09:00–12:00・受付・休憩1回」. Thin inset neutral divider. Bold14/24 question 「この担当枠をどうしますか？」. Then THREE horizontal radio options, regular14/24 text, zero tracking: empty neutral-outline circle + 「担当者を残す」; empty neutral-outline circle + 「代わりを募集」; SELECTED FOREST-GREEN radio ring/dot + 「空き枠にする」. All have the same original compact round radio anatomy, about12logicalpx; the third alone has an inner filled selection dot. No pills or filled option containers. Align controls/text baselines and keep compact spacing.
Keep exact saved Japanese date/time/role/break count and option wording. Original source date/time differ; do not substitute English source data. Source selected purple radio becomes forest-green #1F6444 to communicate selection; all unselected circles neutral, text #1D1D1D, metadata #6E6E6E. No additional accents, large gradient button, checkboxes, avatars, metrics or new actions. All ordinary surfaces white, no broad gray/mint fills, rainbow symbols, heavy gloss or app backdrop. Only this shift-handling card, not the rest of leave-request page. Static raster candidate only, no actual schedule mutation/approval implied.
reviewNotes: 原画優先で三つのラジオ操作と第三空き枠選択を復元、同じ見た目のミントピルを除外。保存日付/時刻/受付/休憩1回/問いと選択肢を保持、原画公開済み状態を日本語で復元。紫選択は森林緑、他中立白。実画像で選択点/文言/整列/切れなし確認。実担当枠変更/権限/正確な書体同定は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
